tests.scope: V19+V20+V21 geometry/color, identity evidence and OCR mocks, automatic ROI/anchor guards, Korean paired assets, copy counts, data integrity/audit/export, one-start Tk workflow, split workers, mocked HTTP; no physical camera or live server

historical_real_image_tested: one obsolete blue 49 sticker; number deliberately unknown; occupancy not evaluated
limitations: Automatic registration requires readable upright bay names and closed convex quadrilateral boundaries; open/occluded lines are not generally solved.
No trained occupancy or vehicle-mask violation model is bundled. Without occupancy model/reference, no sticker means unknown, not vacant.
Automatic annotations are candidates, not human-approved truth. Complete information counts are not accuracy.
Current D39 physical accuracy and FPS are unmeasured; four of 24 synthetic identities abstained.
Anchor matching is a conservative heuristic and can fail under occlusion/lighting/repeated patterns.
Real camera, GPU, long-duration field collection, live server, Geti import and UI visual layout remain unverified.
No bulk migration of all historical data or automatic duplicate-image filtering was added.
Export copies preserve originals; the result receipt JSON is excluded from data JSON counts.
V21 automatic ROI and prediction files should not be edited by older releases.
